tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che spyi dang*/ khyad par snga 'gyur 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs yongs su gsal bar mdzad pa'i/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa chen po'i zhal skyin nam/ mkhyen rtogs dgongs

spyod kyi 'dra 'bag /phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ de kho na nyid gnas gsum du rnam par gzhag pa'i gsung rab/ mdzod chen bdun/ snying thig ya bzhi/ ngal gso skor gsum/ mun sel skor gsum sogs gsar rnying gi chos bka' dri ma med pa rnams tshul bzhin bsdu bsgrig 'grems spel zhu ba ste/ de yang mdzod bdun dang mun sel skor gsum sogs ni bla rung nang bstan slob gling nas gsar bskrun ji bzhin sor bzhag dang*/ snying thig ya bzhi dang*/ ngal gso skor gsum sogs ni sde dge'i par ma ma phyi'i gtso bo la/ mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas mchis pa rnams/ a 'dzoms par mar dag bsdur zhus te cung zad mi mtshungs pa dag (< a > mi 'dra ba'i yig 'bru ) gug rtags 'di'i nang bcug yod/ 'grel mchan yod rigs rnams shing par ji bzhin glog klad 'dir 'khrid stabs ma bde bas dkyus tshig dang phreng gral gcig tu bkod de 'grel byed du gang 'gro 'gro'i snga bsnur phyir 'then cung zad res dkyus mchan rtsing zhib so sor phyes yod/ ldeb bzo dang dpe deb kyi dum mtshams kyang gtso bo sde dge dang a 'dzoms par ma gnyis las che chung 'tshams pa phyi ma la gzhir byas/ bi ma snying thig dang mkha' 'gro snying thig lta bu'i sde tshan rang rang gi nang phan tshun gyi le tshan 'ga' re/ ma phyi'i pod dum las yar bsnan mar dbris pod dum che chung snyoms thabs byas yod/ dpe deb thams cad kyi mgor chos tshan so sor gzigs pa stabs bde'i dkar chag ldeb grangs da lta'i dpe deb spyi 'gros tsam las gzhung ngo mar ma dpe sor 'jog las dpe gsar 'ga' zhig ltar gyi lhad 'dzud gsar pa gang yang byas med/ de dag las gzhan dus rkyen 'pho 'gyur ci rigs pas/ gang thod thod du 'thor gyar song nas ma phyi re re tsam rnyed pa'i dpe dkon dang*/ do dam dpe mang gi mdzod du bskyil ba'i rnyed 'tshol dka' ba rnams kyang gang nus ci lcog gis/

'gro song dang ngal ba la ma 'dzems par btsal 'tshol bgyis khul du/ rgya che'i chos lugs las rigs mi sna dang*/ gzhon skyes rig gnas lhur len pa tsho'i bsam blo'i dpal yon dang*/ thams cad zhi bde 'cham mthun gyi grogs su 'gro ba sogs mdor na da lta'i spyi tshogs 'di la phan du re ba dang*/ rin thang che ba'i dpe rgyun 'di nyid tshang la ma 'thor ba/ ma 'ongs mi rabs phyi mar yun du gnas pa'i rkyen grogs su 'gyur na snyam pa'i re 'dun gyis/ rtsis 'phrul gyi par gzhir bcug ste 'grems spel zhus pa lags na/ rgya che'i gzigs pa po/ blo dkar gzhung drang gi gzur gnas dpyod ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi rog 'degs ci lcog gang 'os gnang ba thugs rje che zhu/ bod ljongs dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 'gro 'dul rdo rjes zla 10pa'i tshes bzang por phul ba dge/ // bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 3 -- PAGE 1 -
